long_description:
Hamming AI is the complete QA platform for voice agents from pre-deployment testing to production monitoring. 

4M+ calls tested. 10K+ agents monitored. Trusted by public companies and the fastest-growing voice AI teams.

Connect your agent, auto-generate test scenarios, and run thousands of test calls in minutes. In production, monitor every call with 50+ built-in metrics and get alerts before customers notice.

Sumanyu (CEO) was previously Head of Data at Citizen and Senior Staff Data Scientist at Tesla, where he grew AI-powered sales to hundreds of millions in revenue per year. 

Our engineering team ranks #1 on Weave (https://workweave.ai) across 10,000+ engineers and 100+ teams.
